pages.title: Primordial Ejecta
pages.text: Matter a white hole threw out before there was anything to throw. A white hole is a time-reversed black hole, expelling rather than swallowing. This debris is warm and ancient, and seems to be still moving outward.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Photon Moths near white holes dropped these fragments. They were older than anything I had ever found, pushed out of a white hole before the universe began.

Made in $(item)White Hole Emitter$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Ejecta Ore$(), in veins through the white hole interior.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Photon Moth.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Einstein-Rosen Core, White Hole Fragment.
